summary.en: Give values useful names and distinguish numbers, text, Boolean values and None.
summary.bn: মানকে অর্থপূর্ণ নাম দাও এবং সংখ্যা, লেখা, সত্য-মিথ্যা আর None আলাদা করো।

notes: These programs target Python 3.12 and use features available in Python 3.10 or later.

sections.title: Attach a name to a value
Names carry meaning through a program

examples.title: A name can refer to a new type
examples.explanationHtml: The name first refers to an integer, then a string. __name__ gives the readable type name.

examples.title: Five everyday kinds of value
examples.explanationHtml: Counts use int, CGPA uses float, a yes/no flag uses bool, and text uses str. None means no result yet.

examples.title: Two names for the same object
examples.explanationHtml: Equal identity numbers show that both names initially refer to one object. Rebinding alias leaves course attached to the original string.

examples.title: Assignment uses the current value
examples.explanationHtml: Assignment calculates the right side now. total stays 100 when price later changes; the new multiplication gives 120.

practice.title: Store a roll label
practice.statementHtml: Read a roll label as one line. Print Roll: and the unchanged label separated by a space. Numeric-looking text may start with zero.
hints: Keep the input as str to preserve leading zeros.

practice.title: Keep the original value
practice.statementHtml: Read one text line. Bind original and copy to that value. Rebind copy to changed. Print original and copy on separate lines.
hints: Assignment to copy does not rewrite the original string.

practice.title: Count the attendance
practice.statementHtml: Read a nonnegative whole number on one line. Use int(input()) to convert it, then print that number plus one. Conversion is explained in Input and Output.
hints: The addition needs an int rather than the text returned by input.

practice.title: Swap two room labels
practice.statementHtml: Read two room labels on separate lines. Print the second and then the first on separate lines. Use simultaneous assignment to swap the two names.
hints: The right side of a, b = b, a is read before either name changes.

quiz.prompt: What does dynamic typing mean for a Python name?
options: It can refer to values of different types over time
Names must begin with a digit
quiz.explanation: The object has a type; the name is not locked to a declared type.
None is a special value, whereas "None" is ordinary text.

quiz.prompt: Which name follows the usual Python variable convention?
quiz.explanation: Use readable snake_case; hyphens are subtraction and spaces cannot occur inside a name.
type tells you the object type, not its storage size.

quiz.prompt: What does id(value) promise during the object lifetime?
options: An identity number unique among live objects
quiz.explanation: Identity is stable while an object lives. Do not depend on particular printed numbers.

options: True is bool and "True" is str
Quotes are ignored for Boolean values
quiz.explanation: Quotes create text. The unquoted, capitalised spelling is a Boolean constant.

quiz.prompt: In total = price * quantity, when is the product calculated?
quiz.explanation: total receives the result at assignment time; it is not a live spreadsheet formula.

quiz.prompt: After aliasing and rebinding a number, which value stays in first?
quiz.explanation: Rebinding second does not change the object first refers to.
quiz.code:
first = 7
second = first
second = 9
print(first, second)

quiz.prompt: A name changes from whole number to text. Which type name is printed?
quiz.explanation: The final assignment binds item to a string object.

quiz.prompt: Two names initially refer to one string. Which identity comparison is printed?
quiz.explanation: Assignment copies the reference, so both identity calls describe the same live object.
quiz.code:
name = "Lab room"
other = name
print(id(name) == id(other))

keyPoints.en: Assignment binds a name to the value on its right.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যাসাইনমেন্ট ডান পাশের মানের সঙ্গে একটি নাম যুক্ত করে।

keyPoints.en: An object has a type; a name can be rebound.
keyPoints.bn: অবজেক্টের টাইপ থাকে, আর নামকে অন্য মানের সঙ্গে যুক্ত করা যায়।

keyPoints.en: None represents an absent result rather than the word None.
keyPoints.bn: None দিয়ে অনুপস্থিত ফল বোঝায়, None শব্দের লেখা নয়।

keyPoints.en: Use snake_case names that explain the stored meaning.
keyPoints.bn: অর্থ বোঝা যায় এমন snake_case নাম ব্যবহার করো।

keyPoints.en: Identity numbers are meaningful only for live objects in a run.
keyPoints.bn: আইডির মান একই রান চলাকালীন জীবিত অবজেক্টের জন্য অর্থপূর্ণ।

examQuestions.question: Explain dynamic typing with a name first bound to 12 and later to "twelve".
examQuestions.answerHtml: The first value is an int and the second is a str. Assignment rebinds the name. The values still have definite types, so unsupported operations can raise TypeError.

examQuestions.question: Contrast type() and id() without assuming a particular memory layout.
examQuestions.answerHtml: type reports the object type. id returns an identity number stable for the lifetime of that object and distinct from other live objects. The number itself is implementation-dependent.

examQuestions.question: Explain why changing price does not automatically update a previously calculated total.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Python evaluates the multiplication when the assignment runs. total refers to that computed result. Run the calculation again if later prices should affect the total.
